tasks.description: 1.1 Create the isolated configuration/protocol and three-module source declaration; verify the 24 strategies, 72 winner/policy cases, 58-source closure, exact data/software identity, six fixed references, new destinations, 1053 mandatory paths, seventeen matching selection pairs and 4369-file historical snapshot against planning evidence before evaluating any proposed strategy.

1.2 Implement required individual reference adapters with exact recipe/preprocessing/population/software/inference checks and unchanged gates; verify six old tiny formats, audited reuse without refits, whole-absence reproduction only in the new destination, rejection of partial/incompatible caches and absence of unrelated historical-grid execution.

2.1 Implement fixed eligibility, shared earlier global preprocessing, explicit whole-training weights, original local200/global400 recipes, member-subset persistence and exactly-once fallback stitching; verify both partitions/weightings, label/order/unrelated-row invariance, all fallback reasons, global-versus-local class costs, effective parameters and save/load inference at absolute 1e-12 with zero relative tolerance.

2.2 Implement canonical raw probability blends, three earlier-only policies, actual macro-F2 selection and complete diagnostic/contrast tables; verify reconstruction of 93 full scores plus 54 separate subsets, 144 forward rows, 72 macro/pooled summaries, 738 unique contrasts, 96 routing and 2304 stratum rows, including empty groups, aliases, negative effects and key/numeric corruption rejection.

2.3 Add the separate methodological fit-accounting runner and full integration coverage; verify all 72 winner/policy DAGs and type bounds, expected ten current tiny fit calls per complete invocation, independently observed historical calls, retained failed/retried runs and no changes to frozen predecessor tests/runners.

3.1 Run the actual-host predictor-only resource preflight, audit preserved nine-fit sampling/eight-fit ancestry evidence and execute the new sixteen-fit miniature gate; verify original global200 versus explicit-weight equivalence, deterministic repeats, routing, warnings, effective rounds and persistence with original eligibility minima, retaining failures without recipe relaxation.

3.2 Execute the declared development experiment after gates pass; verify actual eligible memberships and work ledgers for 24 reference-base/fifteen derived reuses, 54 local/six capacity fits, 72 eligibility/eighteen fallback records, 93 full scores and 54 subset artifacts, distinguishing any exact absent-source reproduction from current-method fits.

3.3 Independently audit all 84 available-cache saved development models, preprocessing/global weights/memberships, saved inference, stitched/blended scores, chronological rules/masks/metrics and complete tables; verify the actual winner and every fixed reference before freeze, with exported receipts and unchanged historical identities.

4.1 Freeze the actual winner, eight/ten/seventeen predetermined roles and visible aliases, exact deduplicated DAG, training-only eligibility, earlier operating rules and actual per-type cache/work bounds before month-7 scoring; verify the frozen contract against all 72 prospective cases and reject altered selections or excess dependencies.

4.2 Execute only the bounded frozen consumed-month transfer; independently verify every required model, membership/routing, score, mask, metric, access record and actual new/reused work against the freeze, with no losing-grid sweep, hindsight threshold or winner replacement.

5.1 Reconstruct all 1500 paired fixed-decision bootstrap draws independently and verify the selected role-specific development/consumed interval grids, aliases and conditional uncertainty exclusions against direct calculations.

5.2 Produce checked findings against all six fixed references, matched effects, group errors and actual work; verify 72 operating points, twelve curves/60 canonical curve rows and six capacity lines against plotted values, regenerate and visually inspect the figure, and leave the broader objective active if any required comparison fails.

5.3 Update README/project context and assistance attribution with ordered reproducible commands, pins/data and individual absent-source instructions; verify seventeen exact selection restores/rejection and a complete methodological suite in a disposable copy with no prior model/prediction caches, keeping actual tiny/historical/production work separate and making no unsupported full-size clean-copy retraining claim.

5.4 Audit every requirement/scenario and all fourteen tasks against actual outputs, closed logs, frozen source/config/software/protocol/selection/access identities, preservation checks and run/report manifests; verify compilation and `openspec validate --all --strict --no-interactive`, then synchronize/archive only genuinely completed work while retaining negative findings and any unachieved broader goal.

context:
BT4012 Fraud Analytics group project at NUS, AY2026/2027 Semester 1.
Current sources: BT4012_Proposal_BAF_Revised.pdf and feedback.md.
The BAF proposal covers training recency, class imbalance, model choice and
chronological evaluation. Feedback asks for recent K versus historical K
comparisons to separate size from recency, and model-specific feature justification.
BAF Base (Kaggle version 2) is downloaded locally at data/raw/baf/Base.csv,
with checksums and a provenance manifest; 1M rows, 32 columns, months 0-7.
The first study uses Base under docs/experiment-protocol.md and configs/study.json.
Modules under baf/ implement development-only EDA and controlled experiments.
OpenSpec tasks and reports/baf-study-v1/ track verified completion and findings.
The first study completed 107 fits; month 7 is an already-consumed holdout.
A separate completed improvement study uses configs/improvements.json and
docs/improvement-protocol.md: 54 development fits (including 3 adaptive
logistic diagnostic fits), 9 validation blends, 5 exploratory month-7 fits
and 2 selected blends. See reports/baf-improvements-v1/findings.md for
measured gains, multi-metric policies, ablations and conditional uncertainty.
Preserve both completed studies' frozen identities; new tuning is exploratory.
The completed optimize-recall-weighted-fbeta study made 30 new development fits,
15 verified reuses and 108 cross-fitted evaluations; it did not improve macro
development F2 of 0.3278. Its sources/config/software/selection are frozen.
The completed extend-recall-weighted-search adds 36 new development fits,
81 verified reuses, 288 cross-fitted evaluations and two exploratory baseline
reuses under configs/recall-weighted-extension.json and
docs/recall-weighted-extension-protocol.md. It also found no F2 improvement:
balanced LightGBM remains selected at 0.3278, versus 0.3261 for the best added
strategy. Preserve all four frozen studies. The performance goal remains
unachieved; any further search needs a new study. No 1% quota is imposed.
The completed learn-chronological-score-stacking study uses
configs/chronological-stacking.json and docs/chronological-stacking-protocol.md:
12 early base fits, 15 verified reuses, 72 combiner/control fits, 156 forward
policy rows and two exploratory baseline reuses. It did not improve F2 0.3278:
best learned control 0.3271, best stack 0.3268. Higher stack AP is not the F2
objective. Preserve all five frozen studies. Keep all three learning stages
chronological and require a new study for further tuning.
The completed test-calibrated-f2-batch-policy study used three fixed
score sources, 24 earlier-only calibration fits and 42 chronological operating
rows. It tests a label-free batch count plug-in F2 surrogate, not exact expected
or achieved F2. Keep actual F2 as selection objective, preserve all five completed
studies, and generate label-aware development prefix diagnostics only after freeze.
Calibration did not improve macro F2: best calibrated 0.32715 versus 0.32780.
Preserve this sixth frozen study too. It verified 27 base and three combiner
dependency reuses plus two exploratory baseline reuses, with no new base/combiner
fits. The performance goal remains unachieved; new tuning needs a new study.
The completed test-focal-loss-score-learning study tested eight matched native
LightGBM loss presets: 24 new development fits, nine verified reference reuses,
66 forward policy rows and four separate miniature integration fits. It found
no improvement: best focal F2 0.323007 and best added ordinary control 0.323783
versus balanced baseline 0.327802. All 33 prediction results and 14,400 numeric
trace rows were audited, including raw-margin derivatives and approximate
curvature floors. Two exploratory baseline reuses required no new month-7 fits;
selected F2 remains 0.364409 versus unweighted 0.376884. Preserve all seven
frozen studies. The performance goal remains unachieved and further tuning
needs a new study; month 7 remains consumed.
The completed test-direct-fraud-ranking study tested four listwise rankers and
two ordinary binary controls: 18 new development fits, nine verified reuses,
54 chronological policy rows and 27 macro summaries. It found no improvement:
best ranker F2 0.321311 and best new binary control 0.323151 versus balanced
0.327802. All 27 predictions, 99 contrasts, 35,532 query rows and 18 group
summaries were checked; four miniature integration fits are counted separately.
Artificial queries depend only on months/IDs/seed and retain every row and
all-negative groups. Raw finite scores are not probabilities. Two exploratory
baseline reuses required zero new month-7 fits; selected F2 remains 0.364409
versus unweighted 0.376884. Preserve all eight frozen studies. The performance
goal remains unachieved; further tuning needs a new study and month 7 is consumed.
The completed test-xgboost-rank-ensembles study added 12 full development fits,
nine verified references and eight miniature fits. Its 25 strategies produced 150
forward rows without an F2 gain: best new raw 0.326484, best blend 0.325311,
versus balanced 0.327802. All 75 scores, 302 contrasts, 75 pooled summaries,
12 diversity rows and 16 interval summaries were audited. Two exploratory
baseline reuses required zero new final model fits; selected F2 remains 0.364409
versus unweighted 0.376884. The percentile control scored 0.365259 but was not
the development winner and did not beat unweighted. Preserve all nine frozen
studies and their dependency identities. The goal remains unachieved; further
tuning needs a separate study and month 7 remains consumed.
The completed test-xgboost-score-fusion study evaluates 61 fixed raw/logit
single/fusion strategies with 12 XGBoost model reuses, nine reference prediction
reuses and nine separately counted absent-reference-model verification fits.
Its 183 development scores, 366 forward rows and 866 matched contrasts select
the fixed 50/50 logit blend xgb_d4_w1/baseline_balanced at macro F2 0.328907
versus balanced 0.327802; the conditional development interval spans zero.
One final XGBoost fit and two reference reuses yield consumed F2 0.372694,
versus balanced 0.364409 and unweighted 0.376884. The gain against balanced
has a positive conditional consumed interval, but the stronger unweighted
reference is not beaten. All 165 derived provenance records, 28 interval
summaries and 1500 paired draws were independently checked; the figure was
inspected. Preserve all ten frozen studies. F2 remains beta=2 without quota
or precision floor; scores are not calibrated probabilities. The broader
performance goal remains unachieved and further tuning needs a new study;
month 7 is already consumed and cannot provide independent confirmation.

the change remains incomplete. Preserve its stopped source/config/artifacts
alongside ten completed studies. A solver remedy requires a separate study.

versus unweighted 0.376884. All 1500 paired draws were independently
reconstructed, both figures inspected and 35 report hashes checked; the
finite study is complete and archived with all 14 tasks verified. Findings/verification are in its report directory. Corrected analysis
entry points preserve all original fit sources/models/scores and record
separate full analysis identities after a verifier index bug. Preserve both

this eleventh completed study, plus the stopped attempt and ten earlier
completed studies. Further tuning requires a separate study.
